name: growthmore
description: Bank white-label rewards and investment learning product.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @growthmore/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w @growthmore/api" "npm run dev -w @growthmore/mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @growthmore/shared && npm run build -w @growthmore/api && npm run build -w @growthmore/mobile
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run build -w @growthmore/shared && npm run test -ws
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @growthmore/shared && npm run typecheck -w @growthmore/api && npm run typecheck -w @growthmore/mobile && npm run typecheck -w @growthmore/shared
